# `harness.toml` reference

<!-- Generated by `scripts/harness.py doc` from catalog/harness.schema.json and
     catalog/presets/. Do not edit by hand. -->

The single contract of a HarnessAI project. Keys marked `preset` get their default from the chosen preset (catalog/presets/); `asked` keys are settled during the interview; `derived` keys are computed or filled by the AI; `open` tables accept any key. Custom keywords: x-source, x-values (meaning of each enum value), x-effect (what the key changes in the project).

Sources: **preset** — default from the chosen preset (columns below) · **asked** — settled
during the interview · **derived** — computed or filled by the AI · **open** — free table.
✓ / ✗ = true / false.

## `schema_version` — derived

Version of the contract format. Bumped only on breaking changes to this schema.

## `[stack]` — open

Pillars of the technical stack, as `<dimension> = "<choice>"` (e.g. `frontend = "react"`). Dimensions are free: universal ones come from catalog/stack/, domain ones are derived by the AI. The justified detail (versions, rationale, alternatives, phase) lives in docs/STACK.md.

- `imposed`: Dimensions whose choice was imposed by the user (the others were proposed by the AI).

## `[commands]` — open

Shell commands of the project. Skills, hooks and CI run exactly these. Filled by the AI from the stack; extra keys allowed.

- `install`: Install dependencies.
- `dev`: Run the project locally.
- `build`: Build for release.
- `format`: Format the code (writes).
- `lint`: Lint the code.
- `typecheck`: Static type checking.
- `test`: Unit and integration tests.
- `test_e2e`: End-to-end tests.
- `audit`: Dependency vulnerability audit.
- `verify`: The full quality gate: everything the contract requires, in one command.

## `[project]`

Identity of the project.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | asked |  |  |  |  |  |
| `description` | string | asked (default empty) |  |  |  |  |  |
| `preset` | `prototype` · `poc` · `mvp` · `small` · `large` | asked |  |  |  |  |  |
| `types` | list of string | asked (default ∅) |  |  |  |  |  |
| `visibility` | `private` · `public` | asked (default `private`) |  |  |  |  |  |
| `license` | string | asked (default `none`) |  |  |  |  |  |
| `languages` | table | asked (default docs=`en`, code=`en`, commits=`en`) |  |  |  |  |  |

- **`name`** — Human-readable project name.
- **`description`** — One-sentence pitch: what it does and for whom.
- **`preset`** — Quality preset providing the defaults of every `preset` key.
  - `prototype`: show an idea or a UX to someone; may be thrown away
  - `poc`: prove a technical feasibility (one risky question); thrown away
  - `mvp`: first usable version for real users
  - `small`: a project meant to last, limited scope
  - `large`: production, many features, long-lived, possibly a team
- **`types`** — Free tags describing the kind of project (e.g. web, mobile, backend, iot, cli, data). Guides the AI when deriving domain stack dimensions and standards.
- **`visibility`** — Whether the project is published. `public` adds LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md.
  - `private`: no public-facing community files
  - `public`: open source or publicly visible
- **`license`** — SPDX licence identifier (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0), or `none`.
- **`languages`** — Languages used in the project. Codes such as `en`, `fr`, `pt-BR`. `docs`: framing docs and AGENTS.md prose; `code`: identifiers and comments; `commits`: proposed commit messages. The interview proposes the user's language for `docs`.

## `[workflow]`

How the work is carried out with the agent.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `methodology` | `none` · `spec-driven` · `tdd` | preset | `none` | `none` | `spec-driven` | `spec-driven` | `spec-driven` |
| `plan_before_code` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `review` | `none` · `self` · `agent` | preset | `none` | `none` | `self` | `self` | `agent` |
| `agent_commits` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ |

- **`methodology`** — Development method followed by /implement.
  - `none`: code directly from the task
  - `spec-driven`: spec → plan → tasks → code; each step validated
  - `tdd`: spec-driven, and every behaviour starts with a failing test
- **`plan_before_code`** — The agent presents a plan and waits for approval before writing code.
- **`review`** — Review performed before a task is declared done.
  - `none`: no systematic review
  - `self`: the agent re-reads its own diff against the contract
  - `agent`: a dedicated reviewer sub-agent reviews the diff
- **`agent_commits`** — The agent may run `git commit` / `git push`. When false, it proposes a commit message and the user commits.

## `[git]`

Version control conventions.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hosting` | `none` · `github` · `gitlab` · `other` | asked (default `none`) |  |  |  |  |  |
| `branching` | `trunk` · `feature-branches` | preset | `trunk` | `trunk` | `feature-branches` | `feature-branches` | `feature-branches` |
| `commit_convention` | `none` · `conventional` | preset | `none` | `none` | `conventional` | `conventional` | `conventional` |
| `issues` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ |

- **`hosting`** — Where the repository is hosted. Selects the CI provider and enables PR templates and issues.
- **`branching`** — Branching model.
  - `trunk`: work directly on the main branch
  - `feature-branches`: one branch per task, merged through a pull request
- **`commit_convention`** — Commit message convention.
  - `none`: free-form messages
  - `conventional`: Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, chore:…)
- **`issues`** — /plan creates issues on the hosting platform for each task.

## `[code]`

Static code quality.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `formatter` | boolean | preset | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `linter` | `off` · `recommended` · `strict` | preset | `recommended` | `recommended` | `recommended` | `strict` | `strict` |
| `typecheck` | `off` · `standard` · `strict` | preset | `standard` | `standard` | `strict` | `strict` | `strict` |
| `max_complexity` | integer | preset | 0 | 0 | 15 | 12 | 10 |
| `max_duplication_pct` | number | preset | 0 | 0 | 0 | 5 | 3 |

- **`formatter`** — An automatic formatter is configured and applied.
- **`linter`** — Linter strictness.
  - `off`: no linter
  - `recommended`: the tool's recommended rule set
  - `strict`: recommended + stricter rules, warnings fail the gate
- **`typecheck`** — Static typing strictness, when the language supports it.
  - `off`: no type checking
  - `standard`: default checker settings
  - `strict`: strictest mode (e.g. TypeScript strict, mypy --strict)
- **`max_complexity`** — Maximum cyclomatic complexity per function. 0 disables the check.
- **`max_duplication_pct`** — Maximum share of duplicated code, in percent. 0 disables the check.

## `[tests]`

Automated tests.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `unit` | `off` · `critical` · `business` · `all` | preset | `off` | `off` | `critical` | `business` | `business` |
| `integration` | `off` · `critical` · `broad` | preset | `off` | `off` | `critical` | `critical` | `broad` |
| `e2e` | `off` · `critical` · `broad` | preset | `off` | `off` | `critical` | `critical` | `broad` |
| `coverage_min` | 0–100 | preset | 0 | 0 | 80 | 99 | 99 |
| `mutation` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ |

- **`unit`** — Scope of unit tests.
  - `off`: no unit tests
  - `critical`: critical logic only
  - `business`: all business logic
  - `all`: all code except generated code and configuration
- **`integration`** — Scope of integration tests (database, external services, API).
  - `off`: no integration tests
  - `critical`: critical paths only
  - `broad`: every integration point
- **`e2e`** — Scope of end-to-end tests.
  - `off`: no end-to-end tests
  - `critical`: critical user journeys only
  - `broad`: all main user journeys
- **`coverage_min`** — Minimum line coverage, in percent, excluding generated code and configuration. 0 disables the check. /review also checks that tests make real assertions, so coverage is not gamed.
- **`mutation`** — Mutation testing, to measure how much the tests actually catch.

## `[security]`

Security requirements.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `level` | 0–3 | preset | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| `standards` | list of string | derived (default ∅) |  |  |  |  |  |
| `dependency_audit` | `off` · `report` · `block` | preset | `off` | `off` | `report` | `report` | `block` |
| `secrets_scan` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `sast` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `threat_model` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ |

- **`level`** — Security level, mapped onto the levels of the reference standards in `standards` (e.g. OWASP ASVS L1–L3).
  - `0`: no formal requirement
  - `1`: baseline: common vulnerabilities covered (ASVS L1)
  - `2`: standard for apps handling sensitive data (ASVS L2)
  - `3`: high assurance (ASVS L3)
- **`standards`** — Reference security standards, chosen by the AI for the project's domain (e.g. OWASP ASVS, OWASP MASVS, ETSI EN 303 645).
- **`dependency_audit`** — Vulnerability audit of dependencies.
  - `off`: no audit
  - `report`: vulnerabilities reported, the gate still passes
  - `block`: high or critical vulnerabilities fail the gate
- **`secrets_scan`** — Scan for committed secrets.
- **`sast`** — Static application security testing.
- **`threat_model`** — A threat model is written and maintained (docs/THREAT_MODEL.md).

## `[performance]`

Performance requirements.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `budgets` | `off` · `measured` · `enforced` | preset | `off` | `off` | `measured` | `measured` | `enforced` |

- **`budgets`** — How performance targets are treated.
  - `off`: no targets
  - `measured`: targets defined and measured, not blocking
  - `enforced`: targets checked in CI; a regression fails the build
- **`targets`** — Domain-specific targets proposed by the AI, as `<metric> = <number>` (e.g. `lcp_ms = 2500`, `api_p95_ms = 300`, `firmware_ram_kb = 256`).
- **`load_testing`** — Load tests are written and run before releases.

Behaviour under failure.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |

| `error_handling` | `basic` · `structured` · `resilient` | preset | `basic` | `basic` | `structured` | `structured` | `resilient` |

- **`error_handling`** — Error handling discipline.
  - `basic`: errors caught at the boundaries, clear message to the user
  - `structured`: typed errors, uniform error format for APIs
  - `resilient`: structured + timeouts, retries, graceful degradation

## `[ops]`

Tooling, delivery and environments.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `toolchain` | `mise` · `none` | preset | `mise` | `mise` | `mise` | `mise` | `mise` |
| `ci` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `cd` | `none` · `manual` · `auto` | preset | `none` | `none` | `manual` | `manual` | `auto` |
| `environments` | list of string | preset | `local` | `local` | `local`, `production` | `local`, `production` | `local`, `staging`, `production` |
| `deploy_target` | string | asked (default empty) |  |  |  |  |  |
| `containers` | `none` · `dev-services` · `full` | preset | `none` | `none` | `dev-services` | `dev-services` | `full` |
| `devcontainer` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ |
| `dependency_updates` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |

- **`toolchain`** — How tool versions are pinned and installed.
  - `mise`: mise.toml pins every tool; `mise install` sets up the machine
  - `none`: the user manages tools manually
- **`ci`** — Continuous integration runs `commands.verify` on every change. The provider follows `git.hosting`.
- **`cd`** — Deployment automation.
  - `none`: no deployment
  - `manual`: deployment scripted, triggered by a human
  - `auto`: deployment triggered automatically after the gate passes
- **`environments`** — Environments the project runs in.
- **`deploy_target`** — Free description of where the project is deployed (e.g. Vercel, Fly.io, VPS with Docker, app stores). Empty if not decided.
- **`containers`** — Use of containers.
  - `none`: no containers
  - `dev-services`: local services (database, cache…) run in containers
  - `full`: the application itself is containerised too
- **`devcontainer`** — A devcontainer describes the full development environment.
- **`dependency_updates`** — Automated dependency update pull requests (Dependabot, Renovate…).

## `[agent]`

Behaviour and configuration of AI agents on the project.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `autonomy` | `supervised` · `balanced` · `autonomous` | preset | `balanced` | `balanced` | `balanced` | `balanced` | `balanced` |
| `adapters` | list of string | asked (default ∅) |  |  |  |  |  |
| `mcp_servers` | list of string | asked (default ∅) |  |  |  |  |  |

- **`autonomy`** — How freely the agent acts; translated into each agent's permission settings.
  - `supervised`: asks before editing files or running commands
  - `balanced`: edits and runs project commands freely, asks for anything outside the project or irreversible
  - `autonomous`: acts freely within the project; still never commits unless allowed
- **`adapters`** — Agents for which specific configuration is generated (e.g. claude, cursor, copilot). AGENTS.md is always generated.
- **`mcp_servers`** — MCP servers configured for the project (e.g. context7, playwright).

## `[agent.hooks]`

Automatic actions run by agents that support hooks. For other agents, the same rules are written in AGENTS.md.

| Key | Values | Source | prototype | poc | mvp | small | large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format_on_edit` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `self_review` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `verify_on_stop` | boolean | preset | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `block_git_commit` | boolean | derived |  |  |  |  |  |

- **`format_on_edit`** — Run the formatter after each file edit.
- **`self_review`** — At the end of a turn that modified files, send the agent back once to re-read its diff against CONTEXT.md, the ADRs and QUALITY.md.
- **`verify_on_stop`** — At the end of a turn, run `commands.verify`; on failure, send the agent back to fix it.
- **`block_git_commit`** — Refuse `git commit` and `git push` from the agent. Defaults to the opposite of `workflow.agent_commits`.

## Consistency rules

Checked by `scripts/harness.py check` on the effective contract. Errors make the check
fail; warnings are reported and used by `/upgrade-quality` to challenge changes.

| Rule | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage-needs-unit-tests` | error | `tests.coverage_min` > 0 requires `tests.unit` other than `off`. |
| `tdd-needs-unit-tests` | error | `workflow.methodology = "tdd"` requires `tests.unit` other than `off`. |
| `commit-hook-contradiction` | error | `agent.hooks.block_git_commit` blocks commits that `workflow.agent_commits` allows. |
| `enforced-budgets-need-targets` | error | `performance.budgets = "enforced"` requires at least one `performance.targets` entry. |
| `commit-rule-not-enforced` | warning | `workflow.agent_commits = false` without `agent.hooks.block_git_commit`: the rule is only written in AGENTS.md. |
| `ci-needs-hosting` | warning | `ops.ci = true` but `git.hosting = "none"`: CI is generated once hosting is chosen. |
| `cd-needs-ci` | warning | `ops.cd` is set but `ops.ci = false`: deployments would not be gated. |
| `enforced-budgets-need-ci` | warning | `performance.budgets = "enforced"` without `ops.ci`: budgets are only checked locally. |
| `sensitive-data-needs-security` | warning | `data.personal = "sensitive"` with `security.level` 0. |
| `personal-data-needs-backups` | warning | Personal data without `data.backups`. |
| `public-needs-license` | warning | `project.visibility = "public"` with `project.license = "none"`. |
| `spec-driven-needs-plan` | warning | `workflow.methodology` is spec-driven or tdd but `workflow.plan_before_code = false`. |
| `verify-hook-needs-command` | warning | `agent.hooks.verify_on_stop = true` but `commands.verify` is not set. |
